trigger_condition: Applicant is an informal collective without legal identity
guard_snippet: require applicantMode and fiscalSponsorMode before starting eligibility review
potential_consequence: Project data maps to the wrong legal applicant

trigger_condition: Organization user lacks authority to make certifications
guard_snippet: record preparer and authorizedSubmitter as separate roles
potential_consequence: An unauthorized person approves legally binding declarations

trigger_condition: One project has multiple lead applicants across grants
guard_snippet: snapshot applicant identity per application instead of inheriting Project owner
potential_consequence: Exports contain the wrong applicant identity

trigger_condition: Creator begins work before eligibility can be verified
guard_snippet: allow preparation with a persistent eligibility-unresolved state
potential_consequence: Users abandon useful work or assume eligibility

trigger_condition: Creator is eligible only through a fiscal sponsor
guard_snippet: model sponsor requirements deadlines fees and approval as dependencies
potential_consequence: Application reaches deadline without an eligible submitter

trigger_condition: Official page contradicts downloadable guidelines
guard_snippet: store conflicting facts and require source-priority review before publication
potential_consequence: Missa confidently presents the wrong requirement

trigger_condition: Grant page disappears after applications open
guard_snippet: retain lawful source snapshot and mark live verification unavailable
potential_consequence: Applicants lose the requirements used for preparation

trigger_condition: Recurring programme reuses URL with changed rules
guard_snippet: key calls by cycle and effective dates not URL alone
potential_consequence: Old requirements silently contaminate a new cycle

trigger_condition: Source forbids crawling or derivative storage
guard_snippet: enforce per-source acquisition retention and quotation policy
potential_consequence: Coverage creates legal or relationship risk

trigger_condition: Requirement exists only inside scanned image
guard_snippet: route OCR output to page-linked human verification
potential_consequence: A mandatory condition is omitted

trigger_condition: Conditional question depends on multiple earlier answers
guard_snippet: model condition expressions and test every reachable branch
potential_consequence: The preparation checklist is incomplete

trigger_condition: Word limit and portal character limit disagree
guard_snippet: store both constraints with source and destination verification
potential_consequence: Prepared answers cannot be pasted intact

trigger_condition: Deadline is local time without named timezone
guard_snippet: mark timezone unknown and block converted countdown claims
potential_consequence: A creator misses the true deadline

trigger_condition: Funder changes requirements after draft creation
guard_snippet: diff guideline versions and require explicit draft migration
potential_consequence: Completed status masks newly required work

trigger_condition: Reused answer contains another funder's name
guard_snippet: scan snapshots for stale funder programme currency and date tokens
potential_consequence: Application appears careless or misleading

trigger_condition: Project changes after one application is submitted
guard_snippet: fork new application versions without mutating submitted snapshots
potential_consequence: Submission history no longer reflects what was sent

trigger_condition: Budget mixes currencies or exchange-rate dates
guard_snippet: require currency per line and versioned conversion assumptions

trigger_condition: Match funding allows only non-federal cash sources
guard_snippet: type funding sources and validate scheme-specific match eligibility

trigger_condition: Award is taxable or paid in arrears

potential_consequence: Winning creates an unaffordable delivery obligation

trigger_condition: Funder awards less than requested amount
guard_snippet: support conditional scope and revised-budget scenarios
potential_consequence: Creator cannot responsibly accept the award

trigger_condition: PDF pagination splits a question from its answer

trigger_condition: Generated DOCX changes layout in Microsoft Word

potential_consequence: Submission document exceeds limits or becomes unreadable

trigger_condition: Export succeeds after application changed concurrently

potential_consequence: Downloaded files disagree with the reviewed draft

trigger_condition: ZIP exceeds destination or device storage limits
guard_snippet: preflight compressed and uncompressed sizes with per-file alternatives
potential_consequence: Creator cannot transfer the packet near deadline

trigger_condition: Portal field truncates pasted Unicode text
guard_snippet: verify normalized clipboard length after destination paste
potential_consequence: Submitted answer loses meaningful content

trigger_condition: Portal reveals new fields after file upload
guard_snippet: require destination final-review checklist after all conditional actions
potential_consequence: Creator submits an incomplete external application

trigger_condition: Submission succeeds but return navigation fails
guard_snippet: support receipt upload email evidence and manual confirmation separately

trigger_condition: Creator falsely or accidentally marks application submitted

trigger_condition: Funder policy changes after application preparation begins

potential_consequence: Creator unknowingly violates current application rules

potential_consequence: Interface conceals a disclosure-relevant transformation

trigger_condition: Machine extraction sends restricted guidelines externally

trigger_condition: Shared application exposes sensitive demographic answers

trigger_condition: Account deletion conflicts with immutable submission records

potential_consequence: Missa either loses evidence or retains data unlawfully

trigger_condition: Uploaded document contains malware or active content

trigger_condition: Internal dogfooding overrepresents founder grant needs

trigger_condition: Users report only successful outcomes
